name: Komal Gupta
message:
They've rightly said that,

“Perhaps the most beautiful part of building something meaningful is knowing that its impact will reach places we may never see, inspire people we may never meet, and outlive the moments in which it began.”

It is an honour to serve as President of The Debugging Society, a community that has shaped my college journey. Having grown alongside it for two years, I hope to give back to a community that has given me so much.

I envision a society that embraces every domain of technology, welcomes every idea, and empowers curious minds to learn, innovate, and grow.

Here's to growing together and building something meaningful.

“May we give others the same sense of belonging that made us stay.”
